title: The export scan passes everyday hyphen and snake_case keys, and its comments say what the code does
why: Lane export-scan-option-key (01:06 CST Nov 8): everyday hyphen keys with a 4-consonant run still refuse (`page-length-limit`, `strength-meter`, `bright-lights-city`), and so does the snake_case twin `key: 'tight_compact'`. In export_page.py the CONSONANT_RUN comment ("at most three consonants") and the `letters_are_words` docstring ("a third" vowels where the code uses 30%; "few vowels do not", false for the lower-case hyphen form) are untrue.
note: Fix: pass these keys with a red case each, and a control where a random value still refuses; rewrite the two comments to match the code ("length" and "strength" are refused by the vowel share, not the run; use `monstrous` as the run example). The lane's own comment-fix commit failed its fix check on that point. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Title by triage. Filed 01:10 CST Nov 8. Lane session_013NEJL2A4zgwDKTvUq4Vaai (export-scan-option-key) started it (coordinator, 01:13 CST Nov 8). Built as PR #1827, with runner 8, merging after #1819; round 3 PASS, net value zero. Hyphen and snake_case keys pass (db-connection-pool, page_length_limit, strength-meter); vowel-less random values such as kqzv_bxjw_tmrl still refuse (lane, 02:03 CST Nov 8). Remaining false alarms moved to step export-scan-key-false-alarms.
